title: Routing config grammar rewrite, typed IR, and migration tooling
creator: Ariella Cho
description:
Problem: Current routing DSL has grown organically and contains ambiguous constructs that make validation, deterministic rollout, and automated migration brittle. This causes runtime edge cases during tiered failover and region-pref fallback where incorrect precedence or incompatible model variants are selected.

Goal: Replace the ad-hoc parser/validator with a two-stage pipeline: (1) a stabilized grammar and parser with clear deprecation rules, and (2) a typed intermediate representation (IR) that captures semantics for region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants. Ship a migration utility (the 'transmogrifier') that can convert existing configs to the new canonical form, plus a compatibility shim for staged rollout.

Deliverables:
- New ANTLR-inspired grammar spec (RFC link in docs) and parser library in Rust for reliability and performance.
- Typed IR definition (versioned) with canonical normalization rules for precedence, weights, and variant mapping.
- Static and runtime validators that surface deterministic, actionable errors and automated autofixes where safe.
- A command-line migration tool (transmogrifier) that emits diagnostics and suggested diffs; optional auto-apply with --safe-mode.
- Compatibility shim and canary rollout plan integrated with Console rollouts for gradual migration.
- Fuzz test harness and a corpus of historical routing configs for regression detection.
- Telemetry hooks (validation failures, migration success rate, canonicalization deltas) to Console for SRE/PM visibility.

Design artifacts and links:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RI/ENG-891011+-+Routing+Config+Transmogrifier
- Proto/IR sketch: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1IRSketch
- RFC grammar diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-rfc/pull/72

Coaches: PM: Leila Morgan; Engineering lead: Marcus Patel; Design review: Jonah Reyes.
acceptance_criteria: New grammar implemented and tests covering 98% of grammar rules
Typed IR defined and documented; round-trip conversion (old -> IR -> old) preserves semantics for 95% of corpora cases
Transmogrifier CLI can convert 1000 historical configs in <5s/config on a 4-core worker and reports deterministic diffs
Automated validator integrates with CI and fails builds on high-severity incompatibilities
Canary rollout path implemented and exercised in Console for a pilot customer; metrics captured
No regressions in routing decisions for existing e2e scenario suite (pass/fail)
risks: Large variety of legacy configs could have undocumented edge cases causing false positives during migration
Parser bugs could introduce subtle precedence changes leading to customer impact if auto-apply is used
Performance regressions in parser/validator under high-throughput QA workloads
Coordination overhead with Console and Dedicated teams for rollout and telemetry ingestion
